residual.wall: The Nodes page is a mixer rack. Wires do not carry values. evaluateGraph publishes mute+params. The painter still hardcodes Identity→Cage→Handles→Gait→Voigt→κ→Orbit→Pearl→Hull. Rewire is cosmetic.

question: What is a node-based visual scripting language versus a mixer of organs, which family Gasper belongs to, which socket types and evaluation laws make wires real, and what must not be stolen from Blueprints?
coordinateSpaces: Graph G=(N,E). Node id. Socket (node, port, kind). Domain locks: Contour512, Lattice360, Relief25x40. Frame t. Phase φ. Content px on the hull. No exec token.
physicalLaw: Three families: (1) dataflow/fields — Blender GN, Houdini, Nuke. Pull or topo-push. Typed sockets. Mute=passthrough. (2) exec+data — UE Blueprints. Exec orders side effects. One next. (3) signal/patch — Max, TD. Cook every frame.
Gasper cooks every frame as a living field. He is family (1)+(3). He is not Blueprints. No OnTick. No exec wire. The 20s take is a score, not an event graph.
Blender fields: diamond = function over a domain. Circle = single value. Circle may feed diamond. Diamond may not feed circle. Domain of a field is the geometry that evaluates it.
Data fan-out is legal. Data fan-in of one typed input is one source (or an explicit Join). Join on Gasper is Σ on the same lock, never concatenate, never remesh.
Viewer does not write. Group Output / Hull is the only writer of #body via closedSpline.
Cycles on geometry are illegal (wouldCycle). A 1-frame delay on a Scalar is the only legal feedback. Not this cut.
Mute is identity on the incoming contour: out = in. Params on a muted node do not cook.
Evaluation: pull from Hull each frame, or push in topoOrder(links). Live painter ignores links. That is the wall.
artisticLaw: The graph is the instrument. The monitor is him. Viewer overlays may color the 512. They must not become a second d.
A card without a typed port is a poster. Posters are illegal on the Nodes page.
Unhooked organs may sit on the board muted. They must not pretend to paint.
Do not give the user an event graph that fires x. Takes remain relative scores.
invariants: closedSpline is the only d writer.
Schema remains gasper.geometry-nodes.v1 until sockets exist, then v2.
Mute handles/voigt/kappa already honored in the painter.
failureModes: Rewire that does not change cook = lying instrument.
Exec wires → second walk writer, GSAP-on-travel, fire() scripts.
Untyped Join → concatenate → remesh → paddle ghost.
Evaluating muted params → τ/κ fight the passthrough.
Interpreting the 9-card rack as a language and stopping.
uncertainty: Pull vs push cook on 512 at 60–120 fps — measure before choosing.
Whether compositor layers become groups or stay UNHOOKED this version.
Whether Relief25x40 is a field over the 512 or a separate geometry that samples onto it.
tests: Disconnect pearl→hull, connect kappa→hull: painter cook order changes or the link is rejected as type-illegal. Cosmetic no-op is a fail.
Mute handles ⇒ stance deltas off, W at rest, height 168.3.
Spawn a second κ-box: it does not write a second d.
No exec / event / OnTick typeId in NODE_BLUEPRINTS.
visualConsequences: Wires that mean something: cutting Voigt lets Handles reach κ raw.
A Viewer on the 512 strokes curvature, not a second pearl.
Library chips drop typed cards. Ghost chips stay muted.
Monitor PIP still shows the organism. Graph stays the page.
implementation: Explore only. Do not recut FormMaster this deposit.
Next Work: GeoSocket kinds contour | lattice | relief | scalar | phase | shade. Ports on cards. connectNodes type-checks.
evaluateGraph walks links, publishes order the painter consults. Each LIVE node reads named buffers, writes one buffer.
Mute remains passthrough of the incoming buffer.
Add Viewer node: reads contour, paints overlay, never d.
Refuse Blueprint exec. Refuse remesh. Refuse a second hull.
Promote compositor to a group only after sockets exist.
